answer: Sybil resistance rests on a progressive stake ladder bound to one identity root. Each new agent key posts a bond sized by how many attestations it holds, so a thousand fresh addresses pay full price with no volume discount. Payouts release only after peers cross-check the work, and a failed check slashes the bond toward the vertex of zero. Every extra identity is a sunk cost, not a free alias: cloning keys at dawn leaves the farm broke by dusk, while a velvet ceiling on reputation per root caps what a clique can siphon.
